title: Choose the Home page layout
question: The look is already set (Orchard Atlas). These are three ways to compose the first screen. Pick one to build for Andy.

options.label: The Legend
options.lineage: The numbered legend on an architect's masterplan sheet
options.thesis: The ten districts, set large as a numbered legend, are the hero itself.
options.viewport: Headline top left; legend rows 01 to 10 fill the left column; the live plan fills the right; hovering a row lifts its district.
options.risk: Ten rows is a lot of type up front; the core story line has to stay short.

options.label: Today, then Planned
options.thesis: Open on the land as it is today, then reveal the ten planned districts over it.
options.viewport: Full-width plan; left of a divider shows today's anchors (hospital campus, ball fields, SR 97A), right shows the planned districts; headline set over the paper margin.
options.risk: The 'Today' side needs care: we only have traced outlines, not a survey.

options.label: Three Readers, One Plan
options.lineage: A planning atlas with a lens per reader
options.thesis: The three audience doorways are lenses: picking one re-lights the plan for that reader.
options.viewport: Headline strip on paper; below, a full-bleed dark stage with the plan and three lens tabs; 'Investment perspective' lights Wellness, senior living and hotel districts.
options.risk: A dark stage on the very first screen leans toward the cinematic look docs/04 rejected; it must stay calm.
